title: Qualcomm signs a multiyear SpaceX deal to supply Dragonwing hardware and network software for "tens of thousands of cell sites" for a US-wide 5G network in 2027 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Qualcomm signs a multiyear SpaceX deal to supply Dragonwing hardware and network software for “tens of thousands of cell sites” for a US-wide 5G network in 2027 — Qualcomm Inc. will supply hardware components for SpaceX's planned nationwide terrestrial wireless network …
